objective: R75A: iniciar la reparacion historica real de detalle ISCAM para ESTELAR sobre 2025-06-12 a 2025-06-19 inclusive. Usar el backfill canonico ya corregido por R73: PAX una sola vez por ticket, ventas tolerancia 0.05, tickets y PAX exactos. Idempotente: saltar YA_CONCILIADO, omitir SIN_RUNTIME y escribir exclusivamente dias con OK_HEADER_CANONICO. No recalcular Runtime, no tocar Sync_Sales, Finanzas_CortesCaja, logica certificada de reportes ni Produccion.

queries.name: estelar_r75a_post_backfill_coverage
queries.sql: WITH rt AS ( SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha_operacion, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS ventas_runtime, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) AS tickets_runtime, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) AS pax_runtime FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ESTELAR' AND fecha_operacion >= '2025-06-12' AND fecha_operacion < '2025-06-20' GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) ), dt AS ( SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha_operacion, numero_ticket, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS ventas_ticket, MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) AS pax_ticket FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ESTELAR' AND fecha_operacion >= '2025-06-12' AND fecha_operacion < '2025-06-20' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date), numero_ticket ), det AS ( SELECT fecha_operacion, SUM(ventas_ticket) AS ventas_detalle, COUNT(*) AS tickets_detalle, SUM(pax_ticket) AS pax_detalle FROM dt GROUP BY fecha_operacion ) SELECT rt.fecha_operacion AS fecha, CAST(rt.ventas_runtime AS decimal(19,2)) AS ventas_runtime, CAST(ISNULL(det.ventas_detalle,0) AS decimal(19,2)) AS ventas_detalle, rt.tickets_runtime, ISNULL(det.tickets_detalle,0) AS tickets_detalle, rt.pax_runtime, ISNULL(det.pax_detalle,0) AS pax_detalle FROM rt LEFT JOIN det ON det.fecha_operacion=rt.fecha_operacion ORDER BY rt.fecha_operacion
